# Pager Studio

Pager Studio is a specialist AI visibility agency for healthcare practices
in India. We help clinic owners and practice managers get discovered and
recommended inside AI platforms including ChatGPT, Google Gemini,
Perplexity, Claude, Grok, Meta AI, and Google AI Overviews.

## What We Do

We audit how healthcare practices appear across AI platforms, identify
citation gaps and competitor advantages, implement structured data and
schema markup, build authority content optimized for AI citation, manage
physician and clinic directory profiles, and track visibility movement
monthly across 3 to 7 AI platforms.

## Services

Free AI Visibility Audit: We run your practice through live AI prompts
on ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews and deliver a structured citation
report within 48 hours. No credit card. No commitment.

Paid Implementation: Monthly retainer plans called Foundation, Authority,
and Dominant. Includes schema markup, authority content creation, physician
profile optimization, directory citation management, and ongoing monitoring.
Minimum six-month engagement. Authority and Dominant plans include
exclusivity — one clinic per specialty per city.

Monthly Monitoring: Citation tracking across all major AI platforms with
monthly reports covering visibility score, month-on-month movement, and
competitor comparison.

## Specialties Served

IVF and Fertility, Dental Implants, Cosmetic Dermatology, LASIK Eye Surgery,
Hair Transplant, Plastic Surgery.

## Business Model

Pager Studio works exclusively with practice owners and clinic managers.
This is a B2B service. We do not work with patients directly and do not
provide medical advice of any kind.
